---
title: "Update configuration"
---

Use the complete maintenance workflow to refresh the repository and installed
software before reapplying and auditing the workstation configuration:

```sh
make update
```

In order, this command:

1. runs `git pull --ff-only` on a branch, or preserves a detached checkout and
   prints a notice;
2. refreshes Fedora packages with `sudo dnf upgrade --refresh`;
3. refreshes Flatpak applications with `flatpak update`;
4. runs the same `make configure` workflow described in
   [Apply configuration](install_configuration.qmd); and
5. runs `make audit`.

The update stops when a step fails. It does not switch a detached checkout to a
branch or newer tag. Fedora and Flatpak prompts remain interactive so that you
can review consequential changes.

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

Review the final play recap and audit output, then confirm that the checkout is
clean:

```sh
git status --short
```
:::
